Mukundan, Managing Director & CEO, Tata Chemicals Limited, said, “During Q2FY27, Tata Chemicals Limited delivered a resilient operating performance in a challenging global environment. Higher sales, production volumes, improved operating efficiencies and disciplined cost management helped mitigate the impact of continued pressure on soda ash prices and elevated input, energy and logistics costs. Market conditions for soda ash remain challenging, with global oversupply, subdued demand and evolving trade flows continuing to weigh on prices and realisations. Exports from the US to Southeast Asia were particularly impacted by unremunerative pricing. In this environment, our immediate priorities remain operational excellence, structural cost reduction, cash generation and disciplined capital allocation. Despite a resilient standalone operating performance, our consolidated results were impacted by a sharp rise in UK natural gas costs. The prolonged Middle East conflict continued to drive inflation in key inputs, including limestone and CO₂, as well as energy, freight, and logistics costs across our operations. Additionally, the temporary suspension of Kenya operations weighed on consolidated performance. We continue to advance our LIFE strategy, progressively shaping the portfolio towards sustainability-led, application-focused and less cyclical businesses, while strengthening the competitiveness of our core operations. In Living Essentials, the demand outlook remains positive, supported by premiumisation and increasing consumption across food, feed, pharmaceutical and beverage applications. Salt and bicarbonates are expected to provide stable growth, while prebiotics offer attractive long-term opportunities driven by increasing consumer focus on health and wellness. In Industrial Essentials, particularly soda ash, the near to medium term outlook remains challenging due to excess global capacity, weak pricing and geopolitical and cost pressures. Mumbai, 7th November, 2026 – Sejal Glass Limited (Sejal Glass, The Company), (NSE Code: SEJALLTD/ BSE Code: 532993), a manufacturer of high-quality architectural glass solutions, has announced that its Board of Directors has approved the proposed execution of a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) with Magnumtuff India Private Limited for the acquisition of its Architectural Glass and Automotive Glass business undertaking on a going-concern basis through a slump sale. The proposed acquisition, together with the purchase of the associated factory land and building, involves an aggregate lump-sum consideration of ₹40.80 crore. The identified business undertaking, which includes manufacturing facilities, business assets, inventory, intellectual property, technical know-how, customer and vendor relationships, contracts and employees, reported operating revenue of ₹36.20 crore during FY26. Goldiam reported a total revenue of ₹ 2916.6 million for Q2 FY 2027, up by 44%. Total revenue for H1 at ₹ 6553.2 million, grew sharply by 50%. Goldiam reported an EBITDA of ₹ 736 million for Q2 FY2027 which was up by 55.3%. EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 25.24%, up 176 basis points over Q2 of FY26. H1 FY27 EBITDA at ₹ 1775.3 million grew by a 87.8%, with EBITDA margin of 27.1%, up by 550 basis points over H1FY26. Profit after Tax for Q2 FY2027 at ₹ 494 million grew by 58% Y-o-Y; whereas PAT for H1 FY2027 at ₹ 1233.7 million grew by 90%. The Board of Directors has declared 1st interim dividend @ ₹ 2/- (100%) per equity share of ₹ 2/- each, amounting to ₹ 301.11 million. Lab Grown Diamond jewellery exports contributed 91.2% to the overall export sales mix during Q2 FY27, compared to 90% in Q2 FY26. Online revenue accounted for 19.4% of the revenue during Q2 FY27. Goldiam’s order book position as on September 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million. Cash and Cash Equivalents (including investments) were at ₹ 4578.25 million as at September 30, 2026. Voltas continued to reinforce its leadership in the Indian Room Air Conditioner (RAC) market during Q2 FY27, with the RAC business recording 32% volume growth during the quarter. The Company maintained its No. 1 position in the industry, achieving a market share of 17.4% for the year to date ended September 2026, with a 4.2% lead over its nearest competitor. The performance reflects the continued strength of the Voltas brand, its product portfolio, extensive distribution network and sustained focus on market execution. Voltbek continued to expand its presence in the home appliances market, achieving record Q2 sales and further strengthening its market position in Washing Machines and Refrigerators. The Electro-Mechanical Projects and Services business maintained order momentum, supported by an order pad exceeding ₹6,800 crore, providing revenue visibility. The Engineering Products and Services segment registered 30+% growth, supported by Mining and Construction Equipment and Textile Machinery. Across its businesses, Voltas continued to focus on market competitiveness, product innovation, distribution expansion, cost optimisation and disciplined execution, while strengthening the foundations for sustainable and profitable growth. Consolidated Results for the quarter ended 30th September,2026: For the quarter ended 30th September,2026, Voltas recorded Consolidated Total Income of ₹ 2,746 crores, compared to ₹ 2,412 crores in the same period last year. Sai Life Sciences delivers strong growth with healthy operating performance Reported Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 23% YoY, sustaining EBITDA margin Hyderabad, November 05, 2026: Sai Life Sciences Limited (BSE: 544306 I NSE: SAILIFE), one of India’s fastest growing Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CRDMO) announced its financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 2026. Commenting on the performance during the quarter, Mr. Krishna Kanumuri, Managing Director and CEO, Sai Life Sciences Limited, said, “Q2 FY27 was a strong quarter for Sai, with continued business momentum and progress across our key strategic priorities. We see growing traction with global pharmaceutical companies, increasing adoption of our integrated outsourcing model, and continued progress in building the capacity and capabilities required to support customers over the long term. Importantly, we are seeing customer engagements evolve from individual projects into larger, more strategic relationships spanning discovery, development and manufacturing." Mr. Siva Chittor, Chief Financial Officer, Sai Life Sciences Limited added, “We are pleased to report a healthy performance this quarter, with revenue growing by 23% year-on-year. The performance was broad-based, with both CRO and CDMO delivering healthy growth, while EBITDA margins stood at 28%. We continue to expect a stronger second half, supported by the progression of our development and commercial pipeline and the ramp-up of new capacity. Our capacity and capability expansion programme remains on track with a total of ₹621 crore invested in H1 FY27.” Financial Performance: Particulars (₹ crores) Q2FY27 Q2FY26 YoY% H1FY27 H1FY26 YoY% Revenue from Operations 659 537 23% 1,213 1,034 17% EBITDA 187 156 20% 335 281 19% EBITDA Margin% 28% 29% 28% 27% PAT 98 84 17% 172 144 19% PAT Margin% 15% 16% 14%
